name: Online Retail Weekly Returns
citation: Chen, Daqing. "Online Retail II." UCI Machine Learning Repository, 2019, doi:10.24432/C5CG6D. archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/502/online+retail+ii.
description:
Weekly volume of returned items (units) for a UK online retailer, 2009-2011, derived from Online Retail II (returns = negative-quantity / cancellation line items), with lagged gross sales as the leading covariate (returns lag sales, so the lags are known at forecast time). Application: reverse-logistics and refund-processing capacity planning.

Covariate glossary:
- returns units (units): weekly returned-item volume (target).
- sales units lag 1/2/4/8 (units): gross weekly sales volume, lagged 1/2/4/8 weeks.
- sales value lag 1/2/4/8 (GBP): gross weekly sales value, lagged 1/2/4/8 weeks.
preprocessing: 1. Returns = negative-quantity / cancellation-invoice line items, summed to weekly (W-SUN) returned units.
2. Covariate: gross weekly sales (positive-quantity line items) lagged 1/2/4/8 weeks (returns lag sales).
3. Converted the wide (date-indexed) layout to the long-form TempusBench schema: variable_name, variable_unit, timestamps (shared ISO-8601 UTC array), values.
4. Dropped calendar-derived helper columns (week-of-year, month, is-January, is-Q4); a single shared time index carries calendar position.
5. Shipping-delay covariate unavailable (Project44 = paid enterprise) - documented gap.
